The altar is adorned with symmetrically placed brass candlesticks holding white candles, floral arrangements with red roses, and a central golden tabernacle or reliquary topped with a crucifix. The base of the altar features decorative paneling.

The vertical lines of the central crucifix and tabernacle show very slight warping/bowing, not perfectly straight as expected in rigid metal/wood structures, though this is subtle.
